parsed.rationale: The QRS is narrow with very deep S waves in V1-V3 (well over 35 mm) and tall R waves in aVL, and the lateral leads I and aVL show T-wave inversion. The ST elevation in V1-V3 is discordant to the deep S waves, which is the usual LVH repolarization pattern, so it does not count as a STEMI.
